Implementation is complete. I can't verify it though — every attempt to run `npm run test:ac`, `npm run build`, or even `npx tsc` comes back **"This command requires approval"** and I have no way to grant that myself.

**What I built:**

- `src/todos.ts` — `Todo`/`Filter` types, localStorage load/save (key `todo-app.items.v1`, with shape validation + try/catch so garbage or a disabled store degrades to `[]`), `nextId`, and `visibleTodos` filtering that preserves insertion order.
- `src/App.tsx` — the default-export component. Lazy `useState(loadTodos)` for the read path, `useEffect` → `saveTodos` for the write path, append-only adds, controlled checkboxes, `aria-label` on input/toggle/delete, count rendered as `{n}개 남음` (exactly one digit run).

No CSS files touched, no new style files, `tests/ac/**` untouched.

**One detail I verified by reading source rather than guessing:** the Enter-to-submit path. `user-event`'s keypress behavior (`node_modules/@testing-library/user-event/dist/esm/event/behavior/keypress.js:19`) only dispatches `submit` on the form when the form has **no** submit button *and* `form.querySelectorAll('input').length === 1`. My form wraps just `todo-input` — the item checkboxes live outside it in the `<ul>` — so that condition holds. Worth knowing if anyone later moves markup into that `<form>`.

**What I need from you:** approval to run the two completion commands. Please either approve the prompts or run them yourself:

```
npm run test:ac
npm run build
```

If anything fails I'll fix it — but I'm reporting this as unverified, not passing, since I never got to execute either one.
